purpose: Freeze the Stage C1 methylation annotation, regulatory mapping, technical-mask provenance, and pre-biological source gate before any methylation relationship to RNA, RPPA, genomic coordinates, outcomes, treatment, historical GRI variables, or preferred SymC patterns is calculated.

primary_annotation_source.download_policy: try only the enumerated Bioconductor 3.8 mirrors; require package version 0.6.0 after installation; record resolved URL, byte size, MD5, and SHA-256

gene_mapping.rule: split semicolon-delimited fields positionally while preserving empty tokens; trim whitespace; require equal tuple lengths; preserve every distinct nonblank probe-gene-accession-region tuple; collapse exact duplicate tuples only
gene_mapping.on_tuple_length_mismatch: exclude the affected probe from gene/Hallmark conglomeration and report it; retain the probe for modal analysis if otherwise admissible

technical_mask_robustness.primary_track: publication-faithful exact 22601-probe PanCanAtlas representation with no extra result-driven filtering

cross_reactive_component.rule: mask every probe ID in TargetID

common_snp_component.source: the pinned Bioconductor 3.8 annotation package above
common_snp_component.object_selection: choose the numerically highest SNPs.<build>CommonSingle object present in the pinned package; this choice is deterministic from the frozen source and cannot use C1 biological results
common_snp_component.rule: mask a probe when CpG_rs or SBE_rs is nonblank in the selected CommonSingle object; Probe_rs alone does not trigger this component
common_snp_component.maf_rule: no additional MAF threshold beyond membership in the package CommonSingle object; the source object itself is based on common single-nucleotide variants
common_snp_component.minfi_equivalent: dropLociWithSnps(snps=c('CpG','SBE'), maf=0) using the selected pinned CommonSingle annotation

technical_mask_robustness.union_rule: technical-mask robustness excludes the union of cross-reactive-component probes and common-SNP-component probes
technical_mask_robustness.promotion_rule: primary and masked tracks must both be reported; no claim may be promoted solely because one track is favorable

allowed: download and hash the frozen annotation package and cross-reactive list
export annotation fields and the selected CommonSingle SNP fields to a portable probe table
intersect annotation and technical-mask IDs with the exact 22601 PanCanAtlas probe IDs
report regulatory/gene mapping coverage and technical-mask overlap
forbidden: read methylation beta values for biological analysis
calculate methylation-RNA, methylation-RPPA, methylation-genomic, clinical, outcome, treatment, subtype, or preferred-pattern associations
select annotations or masks because of downstream biological results

post_c1a_rule: Only after the C1A source/schema/probe-overlap gate is audited may the exact C1 modal, scalar, conglomeration formulas, missing-data rules, fixed-n resampling, construction nulls, seeds, and cross-layer tests be frozen and implemented. No beta-value biological result may be inspected between C1A and that final analysis freeze.
